$comment: Pins taken before the week a release waits (DR-0157), each for the published security advisory it fixes, by its GitHub id: {"name==version": "GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx"} (DR-0763). devkit models-lock takes such a pin exactly, past its cutoff, and the gate lets uv.lock gain it. An entry without an advisory's id fails both, and one nothing pins fails the gate: remove an entry once its pin is a week old.
